Yummy Choco-Hazelnut Latte
By: Robin Peters
Published: Thursday, June 11, 2015 - 10:59am

Ingredients




• 1 Vanilla Latte K-Cup pod
• 1 Vanilla Latte Froth packet
• 2 tsp chocolate hazelnut spread
• Whipped cream (optional)

Preparation

1 1. Prepare the Vanilla Latte according to instructions on the packaging 2 2. Add the chocolate hazelnut spread to the beverage and stir well 3 3. Top with whipped cream to taste

About

There's something irresistible about a specialty coffee when the sun is shining and you're lounging on the patio on a lazy summer afternoon, or after dark as you enjoy a campfire under the stars. Here are three fun ways you can transform a specialty coffee into a delectable summer treat.
